title: Sobolev Orthogonal Polynomials on the unit circle with varying inner product
summary: In this work, we investigate the validity of the Szegö type strong asymptotic formula for the Sobolev orthogonal polynomials associated with a Sobolev-type inner product depending on a parameter $s$, which is defined as \begin{equation*} \langle f,g\rangle _{\fracλ{n^s}}:= \int_{\mathbb{T}} f(z)\overline{g(z)} dμ_1(z)+ \dfracλ{n^s} \int_{\mathbb{T}} f^{\prime}(z)\overline{g^{\prime}(z)} dμ_2(z), \quad \text{where $s$ is fixed and } \quad s\geq 2, \end{equation*} and $λ>0$.
